# About This Website

Welcome to my personal website! This website is a space where I share my academic background, research and professional experiences, and personal interests.

You can also explore an interactive data visualization dashboard created for P8105 Data Science Homework 4. Feel free to contact me for further discussions or potential collaborations!

# About Me

Hi! I'm Astrid Xu, a second-year Master of Public Health student in Environmental Health Sciences at Columbia University's Mailman School of Public Health.

I received my bachelor's degree in Environmental Science and Terrestrial Resource Management from the University of Washington in 2025. Building on this background, I am continuing to explore different areas of environmental health and related sciences.

I am particularly interested in the potential associations between environmental toxicant exposure and mental health, carcinogenicity, mitochondrial genetics and maternally inherited diseases, and mathematical models of seasonal influenza transmission.
